what_it_is: Aequs Limited is a Belagavi-based contract-manufacturing group operating India's first aerospace-focused SEZ, with vertically integrated forging, machining, aerostructure assembly and special-process capabilities for global OEMs and Tier-1s. It also runs consumer and toys divisions and operates facilities in the US and France alongside its Karnataka hub.
india_angle: Aequs is a flagship of India's private aerospace-manufacturing ecosystem: it was the first Indian company to assemble commercial-aircraft doors, participates in the Airbus/Tata C-295 industrial ecosystem, and completed a heavily subscribed Indian IPO in late 2025 that made its aerospace financials publicly auditable.
intelligence_assessment: Aequs has strong verifiable corporate anchors (SEZ operations, OEM contracts, listed-company disclosures). Platform-level defence work is thinner than its civil aerostructure base - the C-295 supply chain participation and any BEL/HAL subcontracting are the military-relevant threads to track in its filings.
sites: Belagavi (formerly Belgaum) Belagavi, Karnataka Aerostructure sub-assemblies; sheet-metal fabrication; precision machining; surface treatment; assemblies for Airbus civil platforms and C-295. Operates the Belagavi Aerospace SEZ.
